files.help: JBANG_DIR relocates jbang's whole dir (install + cache + config); default ~/.jbang. jbang has no native XDG support. shell-startup auto-adopts $XDG_DATA_HOME/jbang when present (exports JBANG_DIR, points PATH there); migrating is a per-machine install move (its bin/ is on PATH): mv ~/.jbang $XDG_DATA_HOME/jbang.
